mapper.sql: c.id, coalesce(c.title_zh, c.original_title) as title, s.name as source_name, c.original_url, c.category_code, c.publication_status, c.visibility, c.admission_status, c.fact_status, c.relevance_score, c.quality_score, c.final_score, c.featured, c.is_duplicate as duplicate, c.duplicate_of_id, c.quality_dimensions::text as quality_dimensions, coalesce((select string_agg(t.tag, ' · ' order by t.tag) from content.content_tag t where t.content_item_id = c.id), '') as tags, coalesce((select string_agg(e.title, ' · ' order by e.last_seen_at desc) from content.content_event_relation r join content.event_cluster e on e.id = r.event_cluster_id where r.content_item_id = c.id), '') as events, c.version, c.updated_at
mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where admission_status in ('PENDING', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED')) as review_required, count(*) filter (where fact_status = 'UNCONFIRMED') as unconfirmed, count(*) filter (where is_duplicate) as duplicates, (select count(*) from governance.content_ticket where status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')) as open_tickets from content.content_item
select from content.content_item c join source.source_entity s on s.id = c.source_entity_id where c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update content.content_item set publication_status = #{publicationStatus}, visibility = #{visibility}, admission_status = #{admissionStatus}, fact_status = #{factStatus}, featured = #{featured}, published_at = case when #{publicationStatus} = 'PUBLISHED' then coalesce(published_at, now()) else published_at end, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select e.id, e.title, e.summary, e.category_code, e.status, e.fact_status, count(r.content_item_id) as content_count, e.first_seen_at, e.last_seen_at, e.version from content.event_cluster e left join content.content_event_relation r on r.event_cluster_id = e.id group by e.id order by e.last_seen_at desc, e.id desc limit #{limit}

select e.id, e.title, e.summary, e.category_code, e.status, e.fact_status, count(r.content_item_id) as content_count, e.first_seen_at, e.last_seen_at, e.version from content.event_cluster e left join content.content_event_relation r on r.event_cluster_id = e.id where e.id = #{id} group by e.id
mapper.insert: insert into content.content_event_relation (content_item_id, event_cluster_id, relation_type, confidence, is_primary, created_by) values (#{contentId}, #{eventId}, #{relationType}, #{confidence}, false, #{createdBy}) on conflict (content_item_id, event_cluster_id) do update set relation_type = excluded.relation_type, confidence = excluded.confidence, created_by = excluded.created_by
mapper.delete: delete from content.content_event_relation where content_item_id = #{contentId} and event_cluster_id = #{eventId} and is_primary = false
mapper.insert: insert into governance.content_ticket (id, content_item_id, event_cluster_id, ticket_type, priority, reason, contact_email, submitted_by) values (#{id}, #{contentItemId}, #{eventClusterId}, #{ticketType}, #{priority}, #{reason}, #{contactEmail}, #{submittedBy})
mapper.update: update governance.content_ticket set status = #{status}, resolution = #{resolution}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')
